move: foil-masked logo and wordmark: conic rainbow turns, specular band sweeps, tilts
how: A hexagonal mark is a div whose background is a conic rainbow gradient plus a white specular band, masked by an inline SVG data-URI, and the wordmark uses the same gradients with background-clip text. A seek function rotates the conic angle a full 360 per D (opposite direction on the word), and sweeps the specular band across twice per D via background-position with a smoothstep, offset between mark and word so the flash travels. The mark tilts rotationY plus or minus 22 and rotationX plus or minus 12 once per D like a foil card in hand, breathes scale 1.03, a violet glow pulses behind it, and a low-opacity feTurbulence grain shifts by frame.
adapt: Swap the mask data-URI for the brand logo path (any black silhouette SVG), change the wordmark text, and edit the six conic stops for a different foil. Keep the full conic turn and the two offset sweeps per D.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the scene, logo, foil div with mask and the wordmark; animate(el, shot, D) returns a timeline with one linear progress tween over D whose onUpdate sets the --a and --px custom properties, the tilt and the glow, replacing fx.register. Custom properties must be set on the instance elements, not document-wide.
caveats: animating a conic-gradient angle through a custom property repaints the gradient every frame
